question: Which Union Territory has the lowest literacy rate, according to the Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadra and Nagar Haveli.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** recorded an overall literacy rate of **77.24%** in the 2011 Census.
 
• **Kerala** has the highest literacy rate, followed by** Lakshadweep **and **Mizoram**.
 
• The 2011 Census also revealed that the highest literacy rate among Union Territories belonged to Lakshadweep, with a rate of 92.28%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Literacy rate** is defined as the percentage of the population aged **7 and above who can read and write with understanding__.**
 
• Government initiatives and educational advancements have led to improvements in literacy rates over time.

 
 
 
 
 __
 
 
 
 
 1. Efforts Behind Improved Literacy Rate In India - Sehgal Foundation

• The literacy rate in **Delhi** was **86.21%**, placing it in the middle of the ranking among Union Territories.
 
• The **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** had a literacy rate of **81.30%**, which was higher than Dadra and Nagar Haveli but lower than Delhi and Lakshadweep.
 
• The disparities in literacy rates across different Union Territories can be attributed to various factors, including educational infrastructure, socioeconomic conditions, and cultural influences.
